title.narrative: Design support - Cultural and Creative Industries in Kosovo - Design support - Cultural Creative Businesses
Designstöd - Kulturella and kreativa näringar i Kosovo

description.narrative: Målen för själva insatsen är: 1) Underlag till Kulturministeriet för en nationell strategi för kulturella kreativa näringar. Beslut om insats Decision on Contribution Enhet/Amb.beslut Unit/Emb. Decision Contribution ID: 16649 3 (15) 2) Ett starkt utvecklat partnerskap och en plattform för de kulturella och kreativa sektorerna i Kosovo. 2) En testad verksamhet och pilot där bland annat animation och film höjer värdet, kunskapen och användandet av Kosovos kulturarv. 3) Ett nytt programförslag inom kulturella kreativa näringar som syftar till att stärka Kosovos roll inom området vilket ska generera arbete, ökad inkluderande ekonomisk utveckling samt bidra till ett fredligt samhälle.

The goals of the effort itself are: 1) Background papers to the Ministry of culture, Youth and Sports as input to the national strategy for cultural creative industries with links to European networks. 2) A strong developed partnership and platform for the cultural and creative sectors in Kosovo. 3) A tested pilot where, among other things, animation and film increase the value, knowledge and use of Kosovo's cultural heritage. 4) A new program proposal with many other actors and stakeholders in cultural creative industries to strengthen Kosovo's role in the area, which may generate work, increased inclusive economic development and contribute to a peaceful society.

Vision The overall vision is to strengthen cultural creative sectors and industries in Kosovo where many initiatives contribute to a peaceful inclusive society, as well as generating jobs and increased economic growth. The goals of the effort itself are: 1) Background papers to the Ministry of culture, Youth and Sports as input to the national strategy for cultural creative industries with links to European networks. 2) A strong developed partnership and platform for the cultural and creative sectors in Kosovo. 3) A tested pilot where, among other things, animation and film increase the value, knowledge and use of Kosovo's cultural heritage. 4) A new program proposal with many other actors and stakeholders in cultural creative industries to strengthen Kosovo's role in the area, which may generate work, increased inclusive economic development and contribute to a peaceful society.
